text: MCP server lets any AI agent or LLM connect to Penpot for multi-directional workflows
quote: Connect Penpot with any AI agent, any LLM. Penpot MCP server is agnostic and enables high-quality multi-directional AI workflows through our world-class open plugin API.

text: Automates tedious tasks and streamlines workflows between design and code apps via AI agents
quote: Penpot connects any AI agent with structured design. Automate tedious tasks, streamline your processes between apps, and build truly powerful scalable design and code workflows.

text: API exposes extensive object/property access for external rendering and workflow automation
quote: Get extensive access to objects and properties to enable external rendering, workflow automation, enhanced app functionality, and more.

text: Outbound webhooks notify external apps on events like file creation or comments
quote: Outbound webhooks are event calls from Penpot to other applications. They notify that some event occurred, e.g. a file has been created or updated, a comment has been added, etc.

text: Plugin system lets developers build and publish custom editor extensions
quote: Our plugin system brings the flexibility that devs need to create and publish their own custom extensions.

text: Access tokens provide alternative authentication for accessing the API
quote: Use access tokens as an alternative login authentication. They can allow an app to access Penpot's API.

text: Can be run in a private cloud, on-premise, or any environment you control
quote: Run it in your private cloud, on-premise, or any environment you control.

text: Deploys via Docker Compose or Kubernetes using an official Helm chart
quote: Deploy with docker compose... Use Kubernetes in its different flavors: Deploy the official Helm Chart

text: Supports unlimited teams collaborating freely
quote: Unlimited Teams - Collaborate freely with unlimited teams.

text: No limit on number of files, only limited by storage capacity
quote: No file limits - Create as many as you need within your storage capacity.

text: Components are reusable layer groups that keep designs consistent across files
quote: A component is a layer or group of layers that can be reused multiple times across files. This can help you maintain consistency across a group of designs.

text: Prototype interactions can be built by connecting boards that act as screens
quote: Penpot allows you to prototype interactions by connecting boards, which can act as screens.

text: Design tokens align design decisions between designers and developers
quote: Make design decisions that align designers and developers' workflows.

text: Supports responsive, rules-based interfaces using CSS Grid and Flex layouts
quote: Design responsive and rules-based interfaces with wireframes, interactive prototypes, and CSS Grid and Flex layouts.

text: Designs can be migrated from Figma into Penpot by connecting each tool's MCP
quote: Migrate your designs into Penpot by connecting Figma’s and Penpot’s MCPs.

text: MCP server can be self-hosted in your own environment without third-party clouds
quote: Deploy the MCP server in your own environment without relying on third-party clouds.

text: Inspected designs yield code in open standards like CSS, HTML, SVG and JSON matching the design
quote: Inspect and integrate code that actually matches design. Enjoy open standards like CSS, HTML, SVG and JSON as well as Penpot's open file format.

text: Component copies stay linked so updates to the main component propagate to copies
quote: All component copies used in a file are linked in a way that updates made to the Main component can reflect in their component copies.

text: A deleted main component can be restored from an existing linked copy
quote: If a main component has been deleted and you have access to a copy of it, you can use the copy to restore its main.

text: Marketplace offers 113+ community plugins for accessibility, code, AI, and design systems
quote: Plugins (113+): Community plugin marketplace with accessibility, code, AI, and design system tools.

text: Any trusted AI agent or LLM can be connected, with customizable models and design infrastructure
quote: Connect it to any AI agent or LLM you trust. Customize your models and design infrastructure however works best for your team.

text: Data privacy is preserved by letting users choose where and how to host their data and who can access it
quote: Keep your data private. Penpot will never make business out of your data. Choose where and how to host it, and decide who has access to it.

text: A Penpot instance can be set up in about 3 minutes
quote: you can set up an instance of Penpot in just 3 minutes!

text: Since design is expressed as code, AI agents can read and interact with design files to create high-fidelity artifacts
quote: In Penpot, design is expressed as code, so AI agents can easily read and interact with your design files creating high-fidelity artifacts.

text: Developers can use community plugins or build their own extensions
quote: Use community plugins or build your own.
